objective: Produce measurable, persistent, individually distinct economic behavior whose trajectory depends on causal seed, changing state, memory, appraisal, goals, context, constraints, uncertainty, and experience.

claim_boundary.implemented: Deterministic causal identities, bounded state and prior updates, structured memory, ordered episode traces, and longitudinal fixtures.
claim_boundary.aspirational: Increasing resemblance to human economic behavior over time.

memory.episodic: Immutable episode-linked structured records used in retrieval.
memory.semantic: Consolidated structured summaries; audit episodes are retained.
memory.self_narrative: Versioned structured continuity and identity interpretations.
memory.retrieval: At most five items weighted by recency, similarity, salience, and identity relevance.

cognition.fast_proposals: Opportunity/threat appraisal proposes observe, buy, or sell tendencies.
cognition.deliberation: Probability rises with surprise, conflict, uncertainty, stakes and accountability; falls with load and time pressure.
cognition.attention_budget: Retrieval is capped and energy/load are stateful.
cognition.uncertainty: Explicit in appraisal, deliberation, attribution and action values.

choice.mechanism: Seeded probability distribution over every option; motives never map directly to an action.

learning.update_rules: baseRate * (1 + 2 * exp(-episodeCount / 25)); state and priors use separate caps.
learning.attribution: Each trace records internal, external and uncertainty contributions.
learning.consolidation: Durable identity adjustment requires 12 consistent episodes across 3 contexts.

narrative_self.format: Structured versioned JSON, never fabricated autobiographical prose.
narrative_self.continuity: Existing seeds and history survive alias changes, restarts and master-key rotation.

episode_traces: normal market observation with bounded update
high-stakes uncertain episode with increased deliberation
negative outcome with attribution, memory and recovery-capable learning

timescales.immediate: attention, appraisal, proposal and action tendency
timescales.medium: learned priors, habits and remembered outcomes
timescales.developmental: persisted causal seed and autobiographical continuity

evaluation.baseline: Deterministic replay, trace completeness, bounds and secret-leak suites.
evaluation.counterfactuals: Ten paired directional fixtures; at least 80 percent must pass.
evaluation.longitudinal: Fifty common episodes across eight agents; retain at least 60 percent baseline identity distance.

safety_integrity.ownership: Separate wallets do not imply separate beneficial owners.
safety_integrity.secrets: Wallet secrets remain process environment only and are never persisted, returned or logged.

migration_versioning: Seed, state, event and evaluation schemas version independently. Persisted identities are not regenerated during key rotation.
